SELECT c.class_id AS classId, -- 1. 平时成绩分布 (映射到 normalLow, normalMid, normalHigh) SUM(CASE WHEN cs.normal_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalLow, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.normal_score >= 60 AND cs.normal_score < 85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalMid, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.normal_score >= 85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalHigh,
-- 2. 期末成绩分布 (映射到 testFail, testPass, testGood, testExcellent) SUM(CASE WHEN cs.test_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testFail, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.test_score >= 60 AND cs.test_score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testPass, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.test_score >= 70 AND cs.test_score < 85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testGood, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.test_score >= 85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS testExcellent,
-- 3. GPA分布 (映射到 gpa0, gpa12, gpa23, gpa34) SUM(CASE WHEN cs.gpa = 0.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gpa0, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.gpa >= 1.0 AND cs.gpa <= 2.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gpa12, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.gpa >= 2.7 AND cs.gpa <= 3.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gpa23, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.gpa >= 3.7 AND cs.gpa <= 4.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gpa34 FROM course_selection cs, course_class c WHERE cs.class_id = c.class_id AND c.staff_id = #{staffId} GROUP BY c.class_id
